innateAbilities.name: Katsuyu Daibunretsu
innateAbilities.rules: Move action, 6 chakra; Large or larger. Split into mini-slugs of the same NC. Maximum quantity NC, +10 if Huge, +20 if Gargantuan; divide Vitality, at least 1 each, and share chakra/consciousness. Mini-slugs have no standard action and cannot cast Iryou, but can relay the summoner’s healing. Reunion costs a partial action plus movement to a single point and sums surviving Vitality. Can escape restraints or substitute against a physical attack without consuming the summoner’s Kawarimi limit.

Reserve 15 maximum chakra permanently; standard release doubles the reduced maximum as temporary medical-only chakra. Heal 3 Vitality per extra chakra, or automatically 2 per extra chakra when hit. Full rest day to recharge. Distance healing through mini-slugs leaves the summoner defenseless.

With numerous summoning they are henchmen and automatically fail Combat Skill checks against non-henchmen. Common Kuchiyose rules apply. Minimum Gargantuan (Immense). Low intelligence, commands only; do not assign the ordinary speaking-animal behavior.

skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, Escape, Stealth, Search, Alertness, Tracking, Poisoncraft, Flight
notes: One combat-capable swarm has up to 50 bees and Medium size. At NC 12 can become Large; at NC 14 Huge. Up to two swarms (reduce maximum NC by 2). innateAbilities.name: Tadayou
innateAbilities.rules: Walk on water using the ordinary Tadayou rules. Retain the normal chakra costs.

innateAbilities.name: Kinobori
innateAbilities.rules: Cling to surfaces using the ordinary Kinobori rules. Species access does not remove normal chakra costs.

innateAbilities.name: Mateki — Demonic Flute Control
innateAbilities.rules: Command Partner requires the summoner’s Demonic Flute. Without flute playing on their turn, Doki remain immobile and only defend. Flute control does not require a Concentration check for melee. Immune to genjutsu and other mental control. Stealth and Feint use summoner Art (including Expert/Innate Art); no Partner damage penalty. Common Kuchiyose penalty−1. Up to3Doki; for3, maximumNC=2×power−1. Cannot qualify for Senjutsu.

innateAbilities.name: Makyo no Ran
innateAbilities.rules: Summoner technique: partial action, 5chakra, continuous, requires Mateki, Kuchiyose5Doki and DokiNC9+. Creates semi-material chakra worms, reach6m, on summoned Doki. Base damage Kuchiyose level +½summoner Art, +1 once if Expert/Innate Art. Cannot be blocked; pass through barriers/physical surfaces; ignore Hardness and armor Absorption but cannot reduce objects’ Hardness/Absorption.

techniques: Tadayou; Kinobori; Mateki — Demonic Flute Control; Makyo no Ran (summoner)
